items.title: Apple智能中國版11月4日起測試，千問接入Siri等功能
items.title_en: Apple plans China AI testing from November 4 with Qwen integration
items.summary: Apple於10月31日公布，中國版Apple智能將於11月4日起隨iOS開發者Beta開放測試，12月隨iOS 27.3推出。
items.summary_en: Apple announced on October 31 that testing in China would begin with the iOS developer beta on November 4, with a release in iOS 27.3 planned for December.
items.why: 隨着 AI 功能融入手機系統，品牌可重新檢視產品介紹及常見問題，確保資料清晰易懂。
items.why_en: System-level text and image entry points make clear product descriptions and FAQs worth reviewing.
items.next_step: 品牌可先整理中國市場的常見查詢，待合資格裝置開放測試後，檢查 AI 如何呈現品牌資料。
items.next_step_en: Prepare China-market queries and inspect brand information when eligible devices receive access.
highlights: 部分Siri、寫作工具及視覺智能體驗將接入阿里巴巴千問。
首批測試僅向支援相關功能的 iPhone 開放；其他平台仍需取得必要審批。
highlights_en: Selected Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence experiences will support Alibaba’s Qwen.
The first wave covers supported iPhones; other platforms await required approvals.
items.detail:
Apple於10月31日公布，中國版Apple智能將於11月4日起隨iOS開發者Beta開放測試，12月隨iOS 27.3推出。

部分Siri、寫作工具及視覺智能體驗將接入阿里巴巴千問。

首批測試僅向支援相關功能的 iPhone 開放；其他平台仍需取得必要審批。

隨着 AI 功能融入手機系統，品牌可重新檢視產品介紹及常見問題，確保資料清晰易懂。

品牌可先整理中國市場的常見查詢，待合資格裝置開放測試後，檢查 AI 如何呈現品牌資料。

上述安排屬未來推出計劃，現階段尚未全面開放；本次不包含WWDC 2026公布的下一代Siri AI等功能。
items.detail_en:
Apple announced on October 31 that testing in China would begin with the iOS developer beta on November 4, with a release in iOS 27.3 planned for December.

Selected Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence experiences will support Alibaba’s Qwen.

The first wave covers supported iPhones; other platforms await required approvals.

System-level text and image entry points make clear product descriptions and FAQs worth reviewing.

Prepare China-market queries and inspect brand information when eligible devices receive access.

This is a rollout schedule, not universal access today; next-generation Siri AI announced at WWDC 2026 is excluded.

items.title: Adobe：美國零售網站的 AI 引薦流量，每次造訪收入高出83%
items.title_en: Adobe reports 83% higher revenue per AI-referred retail visit in the US
items.summary: Adobe於10月29日報告，其2026年9月的美國零售樣本顯示，AI 引薦流量的平均每次造訪收入，較非 AI 流量高83%。
items.summary_en: Adobe’s October 29 report puts revenue per AI-referred visit 83% above non-AI traffic in its September 2026 US retail sample.
items.why: 評估 AI 渠道時，應同時比較流量規模與每次造訪帶來的收入，避免單看品牌被提及或引用的次數。
items.why_en: Track value per visit alongside channel volume, rather than relying solely on AI mentions.
items.next_step: 在網站分析中分開標示 AI 引薦、搜尋及其他渠道，並比較各渠道的收入與樣本量。
items.next_step_en: Compare AI referrals with search and other channels using revenue and sample sizes.
highlights: 9月AI引薦點擊流量按年增71%。
分析基礎涵蓋逾1萬億次美國零售網站訪問、1億個SKU及18類商品。
highlights_en: AI-referred click-through traffic rose 71% year over year in September.
The analysis draws on over one trillion US retail visits, 100 million SKUs and 18 categories.
items.detail:
Adobe於10月29日報告，其2026年9月的美國零售樣本顯示，AI 引薦流量的平均每次造訪收入，較非 AI 流量高83%。

9月AI引薦點擊流量按年增71%。

分析基礎涵蓋逾1萬億次美國零售網站訪問、1億個SKU及18類商品。

評估 AI 渠道時，應同時比較流量規模與每次造訪帶來的收入，避免單看品牌被提及或引用的次數。

在網站分析中分開標示 AI 引薦、搜尋及其他渠道，並比較各渠道的收入與樣本量。

上述數據來自 Adobe 的觀察分析，尚不足以證明收入差異由 AI 引薦直接造成，亦不宜直接套用於香港市場。報告中的假日預測仍需與已實現業績分開理解。
items.detail_en:
Adobe’s October 29 report puts revenue per AI-referred visit 83% above non-AI traffic in its September 2026 US retail sample.

AI-referred click-through traffic rose 71% year over year in September.

The analysis draws on over one trillion US retail visits, 100 million SKUs and 18 categories.

Track value per visit alongside channel volume, rather than relying solely on AI mentions.

Compare AI referrals with search and other channels using revenue and sample sizes.

These are Adobe’s observational findings, not a randomized experiment, a Hong Kong benchmark or realized holiday forecasts.

items.title: Bing將分開設定AI訓練與答案生成的內容使用權限，2027年2月起生效
items.title_en: Bing separates training and grounding controls, effective February 2027
items.summary: Microsoft於10月30日公布新的網站內容使用偏好，讓網站分別設定是否允許內容用於 AI 訓練，以及是否允許 AI 參考內容生成答案（grounding），2027年2月1日起隨重新爬取生效。
items.summary_en: Microsoft’s October 30 announcement separates AI training and answer-grounding preferences, effective as pages are crawled from February 1, 2027.
items.why: 內容及技術團隊需共同決定：哪些內容可用於模型訓練，哪些可供 AI 參考並生成答案。
items.why_en: Content and technical teams need separate decisions on model training and answer visibility.
items.next_step: 盤點現有標籤，按官方遷移指南測試設定並安排重新爬取。
items.next_step_en: Inventory current tags, test the documented migration and plan for recrawling.
highlights: 網站可透過 robots.txt 或頁面標籤設定訓練偏好；供 AI 生成答案時參考內容的偏好，則需在頁面設定。
使用NoArchive或NoCache的網站應於2027年3月1日之前完成遷移安排。
highlights_en: Training preferences can sit in robots.txt or pages; grounding preferences are page-level.
Sites using NoArchive or NoCache should complete the transition steps before March 1, 2027.
items.detail:
Microsoft於10月30日公布新的網站內容使用偏好，讓網站分別設定是否允許內容用於 AI 訓練，以及是否允許 AI 參考內容生成答案（grounding），2027年2月1日起隨重新爬取生效。

網站可透過 robots.txt 或頁面標籤設定訓練偏好；供 AI 生成答案時參考內容的偏好，則需在頁面設定。

使用NoArchive或NoCache的網站應於2027年3月1日之前完成遷移安排。

內容及技術團隊需共同決定：哪些內容可用於模型訓練，哪些可供 AI 參考並生成答案。

盤點現有標籤，按官方遷移指南測試設定並安排重新爬取。

新設定尚未生效，亦不影響網站在傳統 Bing 搜尋中的收錄資格。允許 AI 使用內容，並不保證網站會獲得引用、流量或報酬。
items.detail_en:
Microsoft’s October 30 announcement separates AI training and answer-grounding preferences, effective as pages are crawled from February 1, 2027.

Training preferences can sit in robots.txt or pages; grounding preferences are page-level.

Sites using NoArchive or NoCache should complete the transition steps before March 1, 2027.

Content and technical teams need separate decisions on model training and answer visibility.

Inventory current tags, test the documented migration and plan for recrawling.

The preferences do not change traditional Bing eligibility or guarantee citations, traffic or payment; they are not yet effective.

items.title: Suno MCP開放早期測試登記，生成歌曲將扣除訂閱方案點數
items.title_en: Suno opens early-access registration for its MCP music beta
items.summary: Suno於10月28日發布MCP beta，讓用戶從Claude、ChatGPT等相容助手內構思及生成音樂，現階段需先登記申請測試資格。
items.summary_en: Suno’s October 28 MCP beta connects music creation to compatible assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT, with early-access registration.
items.why: 創意團隊可把配樂草稿放進原有對話流程，仍需管理授權及支出。
items.why_en: Creative teams can bring soundtrack drafts into existing conversations while managing rights and spend.
items.next_step: 先登記測試，以非客戶素材檢查點數、輸出及商業使用條款。
items.next_step_en: Register for testing and check credits, exports and commercial terms with non-client material.
highlights: 用戶可從文字、錄音或循環音樂片段開始創作，亦可延伸或重新混音音樂庫中的歌曲。
生成歌曲存入Suno音樂庫，使用原有方案點數；公告涵蓋全部Suno方案。
highlights_en: Users can start with text, recordings or loops, or extend and remix library tracks.
Songs enter the Suno library and consume plan credits; the announcement covers all Suno plans.

Suno於10月28日發布MCP beta，讓用戶從Claude、ChatGPT等相容助手內構思及生成音樂，現階段需先登記申請測試資格。

items.detail_en:
Suno’s October 28 MCP beta connects music creation to compatible assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT, with early-access registration.

Users can start with text, recordings or loops, or extend and remix library tracks.

items.title: Crun AI推出對話式創意代理，可選自動執行或先確認計劃
items.title_en: Crun AI announces a creative agent with automatic and confirmation modes
items.summary: Crun AI於10月31日公告推出創意代理，讓用戶透過對話協調圖像、影片與配樂製作，並提供兩種執行模式。
items.summary_en: Crun AI’s October 31 release announces a conversational agent coordinating image, video and soundtrack work with two execution modes.
items.why: 創意團隊可在同一流程中構思及生成素材，並在啟動生成前審批計劃，控制品牌呈現與支出。
items.why_en: Brands can connect ideation and generation while retaining cost and brand review checkpoints.
items.next_step: 先以Confirm Mode測試一份短片brief，檢查分鏡、素材及每次生成支出。
items.next_step_en: Test a short video brief in Confirm Mode and inspect the storyboard, assets and generation costs.
highlights: Confirm Mode先提出計劃，獲確認後才生成；Auto Mode自行編排執行。
生成素材可存入共用工作空間內的Asset Library，再於後續項目重用。
highlights_en: Confirm Mode requires approval of a proposed plan before generation; Auto Mode coordinates execution.
Generated media goes into an Asset Library for reuse in later projects.
items.detail:
Crun AI於10月31日公告推出創意代理，讓用戶透過對話協調圖像、影片與配樂製作，並提供兩種執行模式。

Confirm Mode先提出計劃，獲確認後才生成；Auto Mode自行編排執行。

公告未提供獨立品質、成本或速度實測；方案資格、商用權利及穩定性仍需另查。
items.detail_en:
Crun AI’s October 31 release announces a conversational agent coordinating image, video and soundtrack work with two execution modes.

Confirm Mode requires approval of a proposed plan before generation; Auto Mode coordinates execution.

Generated media goes into an Asset Library for reuse in later projects.

Brands can connect ideation and generation while retaining cost and brand review checkpoints.

Test a short video brief in Confirm Mode and inspect the storyboard, assets and generation costs.

items.title: Google Sheets新增AI填值來源標示，單次最多處理3,000個儲存格
items.title_en: Google Sheets adds cell-level AI citations and a 3,000-cell request limit
items.summary: Google於10月28日說明，Sheets 的 Fill with Gemini 功能新增個別儲存格的網頁來源標示，單次請求上限擴至3,000格。
items.summary_en: Google’s October 28 update adds cell-level web citations to Fill with Gemini in Sheets and expands requests to up to 3,000 cells.
items.why: 整理市場資料時，團隊可透過儲存格附上的來源回查原文，仍需逐項核對內容是否準確。
items.why_en: Market-data tables gain an audit trail, although citations alone do not verify the output.
items.next_step: 建議先以20個儲存格測試市場資料整理，逐項開啟來源核對日期、單位及數值，再增加處理量。
items.next_step_en: Test 20 market-data cells, reopening sources to check dates, units and values before scaling.
highlights: 來源顯示於網頁版Sheets的個別儲存格，方便回查。
10月20日起分階段推出，最長15天；限公告列出的Workspace及Google AI方案。
highlights_en: Web sources appear at individual cells in Sheets on the web.
A rollout of up to 15 days began October 20 for the listed Workspace and Google AI plans.
items.detail:
Google於10月28日說明，Sheets 的 Fill with Gemini 功能新增個別儲存格的網頁來源標示，單次請求上限擴至3,000格。

來源顯示於網頁版Sheets的個別儲存格，方便回查。

10月20日起分階段推出，最長15天；限公告列出的Workspace及Google AI方案。

整理市場資料時，團隊可透過儲存格附上的來源回查原文，仍需逐項核對內容是否準確。

建議先以20個儲存格測試市場資料整理，逐項開啟來源核對日期、單位及數值，再增加處理量。

不是所有免費帳戶即時可用；公告所稱的55倍速度提升，來自一項有95名參加者、以英語完成500個儲存格任務的內部研究，未必適用於所有使用情境。
items.detail_en:
Google’s October 28 update adds cell-level web citations to Fill with Gemini in Sheets and expands requests to up to 3,000 cells.

Web sources appear at individual cells in Sheets on the web.

A rollout of up to 15 days began October 20 for the listed Workspace and Google AI plans.

Market-data tables gain an audit trail, although citations alone do not verify the output.

Test 20 market-data cells, reopening sources to check dates, units and values before scaling.

Access is plan-limited. The 55-times speed claim comes from an internal 95-participant, English 500-cell study, not a universal result.

items.title: Vaani自助語音代理平台串連通話、工具及人工轉接
items.title_en: Vaani’s self-serve voice platform connects calls, tools and human handoffs
items.summary: Vaani於10月底開放自助語音代理平台；10月31日的公告介紹，團隊可透過 API 或可自行設定的執行框架，建立及管理多語言客戶對話。
items.summary_en: Vaani opened its self-serve voice platform in late October; an October 31 release describes APIs and a configurable runtime for multilingual customer conversations.
items.why: 銷售及客服對話可共用工作流，重點是語言、授權及轉人工處理。
items.why_en: Sales and service workflows can share infrastructure, with language, consent and escalation as key checks.
items.next_step: 建議先測試常見查詢、用戶中途插話及轉接人工客服等情境，並向供應商確認是否支援粵語與香港電話服務。
items.next_step_en: Test common queries, interruptions and escalation; confirm Cantonese and Hong Kong telephony with the vendor.
highlights: 團隊可描述代理需求、預聽聲音、配置動作，再接入電話、網站、App或WhatsApp。
框架串連記憶、工具及人工轉接；官方網站亦提供平台入口。
highlights_en: Teams can describe an agent, preview its voice and configure actions for calls, websites, apps or WhatsApp.
The runtime combines memory, tools and human handoffs; the official site links to the platform.
items.detail:
Vaani於10月底開放自助語音代理平台；10月31日的公告介紹，團隊可透過 API 或可自行設定的執行框架，建立及管理多語言客戶對話。

團隊可描述代理需求、預聽聲音、配置動作，再接入電話、網站、App或WhatsApp。

框架串連記憶、工具及人工轉接；官方網站亦提供平台入口。

銷售及客服對話可共用工作流，重點是語言、授權及轉人工處理。

建議先測試常見查詢、用戶中途插話及轉接人工客服等情境，並向供應商確認是否支援粵語與香港電話服務。

10月31日報道日期不等於首次開放日；未確認粵語、香港可用範圍、價格或獨立成效。
items.detail_en:
Vaani opened its self-serve voice platform in late October; an October 31 release describes APIs and a configurable runtime for multilingual customer conversations.

Teams can describe an agent, preview its voice and configure actions for calls, websites, apps or WhatsApp.

The runtime combines memory, tools and human handoffs; the official site links to the platform.

Sales and service workflows can share infrastructure, with language, consent and escalation as key checks.

Test common queries, interruptions and escalation; confirm Cantonese and Hong Kong telephony with the vendor.

October 31 is the release’s date, not necessarily first access; Cantonese, Hong Kong coverage, pricing and independent results are unconfirmed.

items.title: 香港案例補讀：Omnichat融資1,000萬美元，擬擴展聊天AI代理
items.title_en: Hong Kong case review: Omnichat raises US$10 million for chat-based AI agents
items.summary: Omnichat於10月27日公布1,000萬美元A輪融資，由Openspace Capital領投，計劃擴展代理平台、研發及海外業務。
items.summary_en: Omnichat’s October 27 announcement reports a US$10 million Series A led by Openspace Capital to expand its agent platform, R&D and international business.
items.why: 本地零售品牌可分別評估查詢回應、產品推薦及成交資料回傳的表現，避免只以對話數量判斷成效。
items.why_en: Local retailers can assess queries, recommendations and transaction attribution separately from chat volume.
items.next_step: 盤點渠道權限及同意紀錄，再要求展示一條由查詢至人工接手的流程。
items.next_step_en: Map channel permissions and consent records, then request an enquiry-to-human-handoff demonstration.

公告列出的渠道包括WhatsApp、LINE、Instagram及WeChat。
highlights_en: The company places marketing, sales and service agents in chat workflows with shared customer profiles.
Listed channels include WhatsApp, LINE, Instagram and WeChat.

公司將行銷、銷售與客服代理放入聊天流程，並共用客戶資料。

公告列出的渠道包括WhatsApp、LINE、Instagram及WeChat。

本地零售品牌可分別評估查詢回應、產品推薦及成交資料回傳的表現，避免只以對話數量判斷成效。

盤點渠道權限及同意紀錄，再要求展示一條由查詢至人工接手的流程。

上述融資及產品資料來自公司公告，本站未獨立核對交易文件，亦未確認產品帶來的額外收入。本篇回顧10月27日公布的案例。
items.detail_en:
Omnichat’s October 27 announcement reports a US$10 million Series A led by Openspace Capital to expand its agent platform, R&D and international business.

The company places marketing, sales and service agents in chat workflows with shared customer profiles.

Listed channels include WhatsApp, LINE, Instagram and WeChat.

Local retailers can assess queries, recommendations and transaction attribution separately from chat volume.

Map channel permissions and consent records, then request an enquiry-to-human-handoff demonstration.

Funding and capabilities are attributed to the issuer, without independent transaction documents or incremental-revenue evidence; this reviews October 27 news.

items.title: Microsoft把Copilot多模型執行框架帶到Foundry
items.title_en: Microsoft brings its multi-model Copilot runtime to Foundry

items.summary_en: Microsoft’s October 28 announcement makes its multi-model Copilot runtime available through Foundry for developers and enterprises building tool-using agents.
items.why: 評估行銷 AI 代理時，除了模型選擇，亦需比較系統如何執行任務、管理權限及切換模型。
items.why_en: Marketing-agent evaluations should cover execution, permissions and model switching as well as model choice.
items.next_step: 建議先以只讀取市場資料的任務測試，比較接入成本、執行紀錄，以及任務失敗後的恢復方式。
items.next_step_en: Compare integration effort, logs and failure recovery on one read-only market-data task.
highlights: 框架支援MCP、agent skills及插件，負責模型周邊的編排與執行環境。
企業可下載SDK或使用Foundry託管模式，自行提供指令、工具及模型選擇。
highlights_en: It supports MCP, agent skills and plugins, orchestrating the environment around the model.
Teams can download the SDK or use Foundry hosting, supplying instructions, tools and model choices.
items.detail:
Microsoft於10月28日宣布，將Copilot使用的多模型執行框架透過Foundry提供給開發者及企業，用來組建可使用工具的代理。

框架支援MCP、agent skills及插件，負責模型周邊的編排與執行環境。

企業可下載SDK或使用Foundry託管模式，自行提供指令、工具及模型選擇。

評估行銷 AI 代理時，除了模型選擇，亦需比較系統如何執行任務、管理權限及切換模型。

建議先以只讀取市場資料的任務測試，比較接入成本、執行紀錄，以及任務失敗後的恢復方式。

公告未提供適用每個市場的價格或行銷ROI實測；這是開發基建，並非即裝即用的完整行銷代理。
items.detail_en:
Microsoft’s October 28 announcement makes its multi-model Copilot runtime available through Foundry for developers and enterprises building tool-using agents.

It supports MCP, agent skills and plugins, orchestrating the environment around the model.

Teams can download the SDK or use Foundry hosting, supplying instructions, tools and model choices.

Marketing-agent evaluations should cover execution, permissions and model switching as well as model choice.

Compare integration effort, logs and failure recovery on one read-only market-data task.

The release supplies no market-by-market pricing or marketing ROI test; this is infrastructure, not a complete ready-made marketing agent.

items.title: 工具回顧：Quantum Metric透過MCP，讓AI代理查詢顧客體驗資料
items.title_en: Tool review: Quantum Metric connects customer-journey evidence to agents via MCP
items.summary: Quantum Metric於10月22日宣布正式向客戶提供 MCP 功能，讓相容代理查詢數位體驗資料，協助團隊分析顧客瀏覽及購買流程，並決定優先進行哪些測試。
items.summary_en: Quantum Metric’s October 22 release makes its MCP offering generally available to customers, connecting compatible agents to digital-experience data.
items.why: 轉換率優化團隊可結合流量數據，找出顧客在瀏覽或購買時遇到的障礙，再決定優先測試哪些改善方案。
items.why_en: Conversion teams can connect traffic metrics with observed friction before prioritizing experiments.
items.next_step: 先以唯讀權限測試轉換漏斗查詢，並核對操作回放資料，確認敏感欄位已妥善遮蔽。
items.next_step_en: Validate a funnel query and replay evidence with read-only access, checking sensitive-field masking.
highlights: 46個已定義工具涵蓋資料查詢、session摘要及漏斗等工作。
公告列明OAuth、訂閱範圍控制，並稱Optimizely目錄已有整合。
highlights_en: Its 46 defined tools cover data queries, session summaries and funnels.
The release specifies OAuth and subscription scoping, and an integration in Optimizely’s directory.
items.detail:
Quantum Metric於10月22日宣布正式向客戶提供 MCP 功能，讓相容代理查詢數碼體驗資料，協助團隊分析顧客瀏覽及購買流程，並決定優先進行哪些測試。

46個已定義工具涵蓋資料查詢、session摘要及漏斗等工作。

公告列明OAuth、訂閱範圍控制，並稱Optimizely目錄已有整合。

轉換率優化團隊可結合流量數據，找出顧客在瀏覽或購買時遇到的障礙，再決定優先測試哪些改善方案。

先以唯讀權限測試轉換漏斗查詢，並核對操作回放資料，確認敏感欄位已妥善遮蔽。

這是較早公告補讀，非本期新版本；46個工具不等於46項獨立成效，亦未核實供應商增長聲稱。
items.detail_en:
Quantum Metric’s October 22 release makes its MCP offering generally available to customers, connecting compatible agents to digital-experience data.

Its 46 defined tools cover data queries, session summaries and funnels.

The release specifies OAuth and subscription scoping, and an integration in Optimizely’s directory.

Conversion teams can connect traffic metrics with observed friction before prioritizing experiments.

Validate a funnel query and replay evidence with read-only access, checking sensitive-field masking.

This reviews an older announcement, not a new version today; tool count establishes neither measured outcomes nor vendor growth claims.

items.title: 香港基建補讀：HKT河套AI Exchange開幕，連接本地算力
items.title_en: Hong Kong infrastructure review: HKT opens its Loop AI Exchange
items.summary: HKT於10月28日宣布，河套港深創新及科技園的創科中心及AI Exchange開幕，連接香港主要數據中心集群。
items.summary_en: HKT announced on October 28 that it had opened its Innovation & Technology Centre and AI Exchange at the Loop’s Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park.
items.why: 處理本地客戶資料的企業，可把數據位置及算力連接納入AI供應商評估。
items.why_en: Enterprises handling local customer data can include data location and compute connectivity in AI procurement.
items.next_step: 向供應商查明資料處理位置、實際服務等級及報價，按業務規模評估。
items.next_step_en: Ask providers for processing locations, actual service levels and pricing, then assess business fit.
highlights: 公告規劃以3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway連接數據中心，使用空芯光纖。
同一地點亦設有 HKT 與應科院的聯合研發實驗室，旨在推動科研成果商業化。
highlights_en: The announced 3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway uses hollow-core fibre to connect data-center clusters.
A joint HKT-ASTRI laboratory at the site aims to commercialize research.
items.detail:
HKT於10月28日宣布，河套港深創新及科技園的創科中心及AI Exchange開幕，連接香港主要數據中心集群。

公告規劃以3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway連接數據中心，使用空芯光纖。

同一地點亦設有 HKT 與應科院的聯合研發實驗室，旨在推動科研成果商業化。

處理本地客戶資料的企業，可把數據位置及算力連接納入AI供應商評估。

向供應商查明資料處理位置、實際服務等級及報價，按業務規模評估。

公告不等於跨境資料已獲批准自由流動；沙嶺集群首期預計2027年啟用，現有資料尚不足以確認成本是否較低。
items.detail_en:
HKT announced on October 28 that it had opened its Innovation & Technology Centre and AI Exchange at the Loop’s Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park.

The announced 3.2Tbps AI DCI Superhighway uses hollow-core fibre to connect data-center clusters.

A joint HKT-ASTRI laboratory at the site aims to commercialize research.

Enterprises handling local customer data can include data location and compute connectivity in AI procurement.

Ask providers for processing locations, actual service levels and pricing, then assess business fit.

The opening does not authorize unrestricted cross-border data flow; Sandy Ridge’s first phase is expected in 2027, with no proven cost reduction.
